formula_observations: FIXATIVE-CLASS POLYMERS: yes. Acrylates Copolymer #2 of 29 (film-former/fixative class; note NaOH #8 is present, so it may partly act as a neutralised rheology thickener, function not declared) and Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate #3 (anionic polymer; fixative/film-former class). Hydroxyethylcellulose #6 = thickener. No PVP / VP-VA / polyquaternium fixative. The 'Halt' claim therefore has formula backing, and the fixatives lead the formula after water. CONDITIONING ARCHITECTURE: fatty alcohols Stearyl #4, Cetyl #5, Behenyl #12 (emulsion base); cationic conditioners Cocamidopropyl PG-Dimonium Chloride Phosphate #11 and Silicone Quaternium-18 #13 (a quaternised silicone); oils only low: Jojoba #10, Rosehip #19. No butters. Conditioning is moderate and sits BELOW the fixatives. G0 read (T15 rule): fixative leads, conditioning thinner than fixative -> Styling, not Leave-in. Emulsion cream, no alcohol, no wax.
notes: Claims from the dm page (C3); the Kao/John Frieda DE brand page (johnfrieda.com) could not be reached (cert error on johnfrieda.de), Rossmann page blocked by bot wall. dm puts it under Haarstyling/Haargel. Real 24-hour hold claim plus an actual acrylate fixative makes this the 'fixative curl cream' reference. Day-2 refresh with a pea-sized amount is stated on the pack text, so it also doubles as its own refresher.
